evidence_scope: development after E1 outcomes consumed; no independent confirmation claim
pair_weight: absolute observed F1 difference; each group weighted by its number of training cells
normalization: training medians/IQR, missing values imputed to training median, z clipped to [-5,5]
score: SDC plus regularized linear residual; pairwise logistic loss within country/area quotas
mse_control: same linear residual family using squared F1 error, same fixed penalties
penalty_selection: global across four models by inner out-of-fold matched-quota F1, include unchanged SDC; candidate must exceed SDC by 0.001 in inner CV; ties prefer unchanged SDC then larger penalty
source_selection: largest metadata-only eligible single-source groups, no outcome selection
source_pipeline: exclude held-out source from probcal and riskcal, buffer remaining calibration/training rows 50 km from held-out riskcal rows; refit probability transform, area edges and calibration-distance features using remaining probcal
source_scope: source exclusion applies to the reliability pipeline, not published backbone PO training; species rarity stays fixed PO prevalence
uncertainty: 2000 shared 5-degree block bootstrap draws, 95% descriptive intervals conditional on these development fits; intervals do not erase adaptive prior label use
gpu_authorization: user explicitly authorizes automatic GPU experiment when tests pass; no repeat confirmation required within thesis scope
gpu_stage: if admitted, private Kaggle GPU replay of the selected ranking head on the fixed saved-prediction splits, max 20 minutes, one job; verify GPU execution and numerical/selection stability. This is model-head validation, not a new backbone or competition score
